arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: the side that brought the case argues discharge ends the jury's legal duty.
the opposing side argues recall protects the defendant from prejudice.
Justice Sotomayor questioned the need for an absolute bar on recall.
Chief Justice Roberts explored the definition of a discharged jury.
